headline: There are massive startup opportunities hiding in plain sight : every layer of the computing stack will need to be rebuilt for agents. For the last few years, most of the focus has been on making enterprise software agent-ready: APIs, connectors, MCPs. Now personal agents are forcing the same conversation for consumer products - e-commerce is an early example. This is just the tip of the iceberg. Now think about the rest of the stack: Desktop and mobile OSes where agents are first-class users Cloud infra built for agents to operate directly. identity, permissions and security designed for thousands of agents acting on our behalf. Interfaces designed for agent and human users or both working together. If you’re looking for startup ideas, go through each layer of the computing stack and ask: what has to change when the primary user is an agent?
